pull_request.body:
## Linked Issue

Refs #3444

## Scope Summary

Correct singular Access enum classification while preserving Accesses, Flags and Miss refusal controls. Retain separate authority-pinned Access and original Miss baseline rebind operations; no GPU source, public identifier or baseline debt is changed.

Exact final candidate 98eff60966fb7917e5085f216501652c98e58d9d is based on the coordinator-confirmed Motion merge c04f6bfcac4849638a9ee59e4a3aa34ceb5bb07f. The complete diff is eight files, 227 additions and 18 deletions: checker, tests, policy, baseline, current documentation, execution authority and two change-contract manifests. All eight candidate blobs are identical to the independently reviewed frozen source 6bce29c5b6c3986e877bb92c3ab9ba5b763db5f4. The final integration preserves that history and has no source conflict.

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [x] Generated output
- [ ] Public contract change
- [x] External naming exception
- Contract impact: none

`Behavior change`, `Format-only`, and `Naming-only` are mutually exclusive. `Generated output`, `Public contract change`, and `External naming exception` are supplementary.

The gate reads fields only from their named section, rejects duplicate fields or headings hidden in fenced examples, and requires contract checkboxes to be checked. Record a not-applicable reason in `Notes For Reviewers` before checking that review item.

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast`
- [x] Targeted backend tests: exact positive allowlist of 16 ordinary C# checker cases passed, zero skips, exit 0 at final 98eff60966fb7917e5085f216501652c98e58d9d on 2026-10-09T08:08:16Z through 08:08:36Z, using official Node 24.16.0 and SDK 10.0.302. This retains Access/Accesses/Flags/Miss positive/refusal controls, both real-baseline rebind operations, expression/declaration and attributed-parameter controls. Log SHA-256: 60ed6b7b461a85d8d30c0785e8310e01fb85b8a0d4b2dbdc92bafee57cbbb5c0. Historical 103/103 and enum syntax results retain their original 0b0a976aedc8e677e099765581eefd91cd70ba1f execution and are not a new run.
- [ ] Targeted frontend checks:
- [x] Other: exact final JavaScript SOURCE diff passed for both owned JavaScript files; original Markdown lint with required tools and document lifecycle passed, all exit 0. Actual final input comparison checks 1128 authority closure files against Git and physical bytes, zero mismatches and 102 targets unchanged. Eight reviewed blobs, producer and independent index are preserved; regeneration is not required. Trusted prospective PR/range observations are recorded separately with their exact candidate and base; live GitHub PR admission remains unrun until publication by the coordinator. Complete SOURCE and held controls are not claimed.

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: final source delivery for the coordinator's Access merge slot following Motion PR #4113. GitHub metadata and merge decisions remain with the coordinator; this source task performs no content API write or promotion.
- Rollback: revert the Access source and its ordinary generated bindings together; retain the original Miss operation and baseline debt.
- Deferred work: live PR metadata check after the coordinator publishes the draft and final same-reviewer integration confirmation. Export follows Access in the coordinator's queue. Unselected product/runtime qualification remains with its consumers.
- Known limitations: full 103-case module, complete SOURCE aggregate, held controls, GPU/native/runtime/release and remote CI acceptance are UNRUN at this final head. The exact canonical complete SOURCE command selects a receipt-control regression port and is not executed or narrowed into a synthetic pass under the held scope. Historical and a281fb6e preparation results retain their actual source/run identities.

## Notes For Reviewers

The complete eight-file frozen source was independently reviewed according to the coordinating root. Every final changed blob remains identical to it; only the integration ancestry changed. The complete final diff SHA-256 is 476b5b4871b0d085c184b6e98bb4f4fb9f4c6d4084dceead83097f5b65f6f44c. Review covers this whole range, not the broad #3836 branch. The separate delegate candidate is excluded.

Baseline retains 33 violations across 16 files and every byte except its authority-pinned policySha256. Relative to c04f6bfc, execution authority changes only the checker's contentDigest and indexDigest. The producer/index are unchanged, all 1128 actual closure inputs match the authority, and regeneration is not necessary. Authority SHA-256 remains dad93142464ccff0eeafdb710d429f14e5ddb6489e213dc5444f6a136af65f5e. No generated output or hash was edited.

The first a281fb6e preparation selected 16 cases and observed 13 passes/3 failures/zero skips because dotnet format could not start. Its secondary missing-command error is preserved. Official SDK 10.0.302 restored the original dependency, and the same 16 tests then passed at preparation 3a90c41fd4cb95d623fbe0ad7cafec641e750e41. Neither preparation run is relabeled as final-head acceptance. The original tests and negative assertions are unchanged.

Positive SOURCE applicability uses the original Git-bound selection functions: three mandatory coordinators and five regression ports. Full SOURCE would run tools/configuration/solution-source.test.mjs, including source admission closed-receipt and Python receipt substitution controls. The denied coupled command is node tools/run-test-matrix.mjs ci-pr-smart --stage source-integration --base-ref c04f6bfcac4849638a9ee59e4a3aa34ceb5bb07f. It remains UNRUN, not failed or passed. Allowed ordinary source and metadata checks are enumerated separately; no held audit, Git replacement, cohort or receipt control is executed.

UI, product API, AEDS, database migration, security runtime, performance and mechanical-formatting items were reviewed and are not applicable to this internal checker correction. Formatter identity fields are none because this is not a format-only migration. Current style documentation is maintained; no new public API documentation applies.
